findings.rationale: The security group ingress rule exposes TCP port 22 (SSH) to the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0), allowing administrative shell exposure.
The security group ingress rule exposes TCP port 3306 (MySQL) to the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0), allowing database engine exposure.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: An anonymous S3 bucket policy allowing public access is neutralized by a public access block, preventing actual exposure.
